description: LEGACY FALLBACK (deprecated): generate CrudPageSchema JSON + minimal wrapper SFC from a natural language description using a REGEX/keyword parser. For natural-language requests use generate_crud (the front-door tool); for a config you already hold use generate_crud_from_config (ADVANCED) — both compile through the same deterministic generator. Keep this only for a quick prototype or a no-LLM host. Produces <es-crud-page> schema output. Supports vue3 (default) / vue2 / antdv targets.

description.description: Natural language description of the CRUD page. Example: '用户管理，查询姓名、手机号、状态，表格显示姓名、手机号、邮箱、状态，支持新增编辑删除'

target.description: Target framework: 'vue3' (default, @es-plus/vue3 + Element Plus), 'vue2' (@es-plus/vue2 + Element UI), or 'antdv' (@es-plus/adapter-antdv + Ant Design Vue). Schema JSON is target-agnostic; only wrapper SFC differs.

name: generate_crud_schema
